note: These preferences are shared with TomoToolNXPlus and apply to future texture imports.
shape_help: Match the item: Square 256×256, Book 256×512, or Wide 256×128.
encoder_help: Gamma-aware prioritizes quality. PCA is the faster alternative.
bc1_help: Choose the color mode for the Gamma-aware encoder.
bc1_disabled: Available when the Gamma-aware encoder is selected. Your previous choice is retained.
fit_help: Crop to fill, fit the whole image, or stretch it to the canvas.
background_help: Used around the image with Fit whole image. Existing custom colors can be kept.
background_disabled: Available with Fit whole image. Your previous background is retained.
defaults: Using defaults. Save changes to create the configuration.
reload_confirm: Reload preferences? Unsaved changes will be discarded.
read_error: Could not read preferences. Check the SD card, then reload preferences.
invalid_error: The configuration contains an unsupported or invalid texture preference. Restore a known good configuration, then reload.
conflict_error: The configuration changed elsewhere. Reload preferences before saving again.
backup_error: Could not create and verify a configuration backup. Preferences were not overwritten. Check SD space and retry.
write_error: Could not finish saving preferences. Check the SD card.
restore_required: The configuration may be incomplete. Restore the backup before reloading. If this was a new configuration, remove the incomplete file.
